# The New York Injury & Malpractice Law Firm, P.C.

> A New York-based law firm specializing in medical malpractice, personal injury, and patient rights litigation with attorney John Fisher.

The New York Injury & Malpractice Law Firm, P.C. provides legal representation for victims of medical negligence, surgical errors, birth injuries, nursing home abuse, and personal injuries across New York and the Hudson Valley region. The firm is led by John Fisher and emphasizes patient rights protection and comprehensive legal advocacy.

- Personal Injury Law

- New York Courts
- Hudson Valley

## Medical Malpractice Services

- [Birth Injury Lawyer](https://protectingpatientrights.com/birth-injury-lawyer): Birth injury legal representation for cerebral palsy and Erb's palsy
- [Delay in Cancer Diagnosis Lawyer](https://protectingpatientrights.com/delay-in-cancer-diagnosis-lawyer): Legal services for delayed or missed cancer diagnosis malpractice
- [Heart Attack Misdiagnosis Lawyer](https://protectingpatientrights.com/heart-attack-misdiagnosis-lawyer): Legal representation for heart attack misdiagnosis malpractice claims
- [Surgical Malpractice Lawyer](https://protectingpatientrights.com/surgical-malpractice-lawyer): Legal services for surgical errors and post-operative complications
- [Undiagnosed Infections Lawyer](https://protectingpatientrights.com/undiagnosed-infections-lawyer): Legal representation for undiagnosed infection malpractice claims
- [Suicide Prevention Lawyer](https://protectingpatientrights.com/suicide-prevention-lawyer): Legal representation for psychiatric care malpractice and suicide cases
